opportunity.name: Autonomous SEO Content Pipeline with DeepSeek CLI Agents
opportunity.description: A fully automated agentic system that discovers low-competition keywords, generates SEO-optimized articles via DeepSeek, publishes to a CMS, builds internal links, and submits to Google Search Console—all via cron on a VPS. Monetized through AdSense, affiliate links, and lead gen.

agent_1_keyword_research.tool: Google Trends API (free tier) + Ahrefs API (paid, $99/month) or SEMrush API ($119/month)
agent_1_keyword_research.action: Agent queries API for keywords with high search volume (>500/month) and low competition (KD <20). Filters by niche (e.g., 'best budget laptops 2026'). Outputs list of 50 keywords per run.
agent_1_keyword_research.cli_example: curl -s 'https://api.ahrefs.com/v3/keywords-explorer?keyword=best+budget+laptops&limit=50' -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY' | jq '.keywords[] | {keyword: .keyword, volume: .volume, difficulty: .difficulty}'

agent_2_content_generation.tool: DeepSeek CLI (via deepseek-chat or custom script using DeepSeek API, $0.14/1M tokens)
agent_2_content_generation.action: For each keyword, agent generates a 1500-word SEO article with H2/H3 tags, meta description, and 2 internal link placeholders. Uses prompt: 'Write an SEO-optimized article for keyword: [keyword]. Include headings, meta description, and 2 internal link slots.'
agent_2_content_generation.cli_example: deepseek-chat --prompt 'Write an SEO-optimized article for keyword: best budget laptops 2026. Include headings, meta description, and 2 internal link slots.' --max-tokens 2000 > article.md

agent_3_publishing.tool: WordPress REST API (free) or Ghost API (free) or Hugo via Git push
agent_3_publishing.action: Agent parses generated article, extracts title, content, meta, and posts via CMS API. For WordPress: wp-cli or REST API. For Hugo: commits to GitHub repo and rebuilds via webhook.
agent_3_publishing.cli_example: curl -X POST 'https://yoursite.com/wp-json/wp/v2/posts' -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT' -d '{"title":"Best Budget Laptops 2026","content":"$(cat article.md)","status":"publish"}'

agent_4_internal_linking.tool: Custom script using CMS API to fetch existing posts and update content
agent_4_internal_linking.action: Agent scans all published posts for keywords, then inserts links to related posts. Uses regex to find keyword occurrences and replaces with keyword. Runs weekly.

agent_5_search_console_submission.tool: Google Search Console API (free, quota 2000 URLs/day)
agent_5_search_console_submission.action: Agent submits new article URL to Google for indexing via URL Inspection API.

agent_6_scheduling.action: Cron job runs daily: agent1 (keyword research) → agent2 (generate 5 articles) → agent3 (publish) → agent4 (link building weekly) → agent5 (submit).

revenue_model.secondary: Affiliate links (Amazon Associates, 3-10% commission, e.g., $0.50-$2 per click)
revenue_model.tertiary: Lead gen (email capture for newsletter, sold to advertisers at $0.10-$0.50 per lead)

opportunity.implementation_complexity: Medium (requires basic scripting, API integration, and cron management)

risks_and_mitigations.google_ai_content_policy: Google's 2026 policy allows AI content if it's helpful, original, and demonstrates E-E-A-T. Risk is low if content is fact-checked and edited. Mitigation: Use DeepSeek to generate outlines, then human review (or agent2 adds citations from real sources).
risks_and_mitigations.content_quality: DeepSeek can rank if optimized for search intent, includes unique insights, and avoids keyword stuffing. Test with 10 articles first. Example: niche 'best budget laptops' ranks well with product comparisons and affiliate links.
risks_and_mitigations.competition: Low-competition keywords (KD <20) have fewer high-authority sites. Use Ahrefs to filter.

real_examples.site: Bankrate.com (uses AI for some articles, earns via AdSense and affiliate)
The Hustle (newsletter with AI-generated summaries, lead gen)
Niche sites like 'BestReviews' (AI-generated product reviews, affiliate)

opportunity.notes: Start with 10 articles/day, scale to 50/day. Use DeepSeek's 1M context for long-form content. Monitor Google Search Console for indexing issues. Revenue grows exponentially after 6 months.
